systemctl stop opute-cluster-agent 2>/dev/null || true
if ! command -v curl >/dev/null 2>&1; then apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y curl; fi

chmod 755 /usr/local/lib/opute/cluster-agent
printf '"'"'%s'"'"' '"'"'eyJicmlkZ2VVcmwiOiJodHRwOi8vMTAuMC4wLjE6OTA5MyIsImJyaWRnZU1jcFVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly8xMC4wLjAuMTo5MDkzL21jcCIsImJyaWRnZVRva2VuIjoidFx1MDAzY29cdTAwM2VrJ2VuIiwiY2x1c3RlcklkIjoiYzEiLCJjbHVzdGVyTmFtZSI6Im4iLCJhZ2VudElkIjoiYSIsInByb3ZpZGVySWQiOiJwIiwicG9sbEludGVydmFsU2Vjb25kcyI6NX0='"'"' | base64 -d > /etc/opute/cluster-agent.json

set -euo pipefail

chmod 755 /usr/local/lib/opute/cluster-agent
printf '%s' 'eyJicmlkZ2VVcmwiOiJodHRwOi8vMTAuMC4wLjE6OTA5MyIsImJyaWRnZU1jcFVybCI6Imh0dHA6Ly8xMC4wLjAuMTo5MDkzL21jcCIsImJyaWRnZVRva2VuIjoidFx1MDAzY29cdTAwM2VrJ2VuIiwiY2x1c3RlcklkIjoiYzEiLCJjbHVzdGVyTmFtZSI6Im4iLCJhZ2VudElkIjoiYSIsInByb3ZpZGVySWQiOiJwIiwicG9sbEludGVydmFsU2Vjb25kcyI6NX0=' | base64 -d > /etc/opute/cluster-agent.json
